Notes: Bulk cap on switched 5V rail to GND

Coupling cap; blocks DC bias from Q1 emitter before RCA jack. 470µF not 100µF: into the 150Ω load (R5 75Ω + TV 75Ω) 100µF gives τ=15ms against the 16.7ms field period, which tilts the picture top-to-bottom. 470µF gives τ=70ms.
X7R 16V+; U1 input decoupling - mount as close to U1 pin 1 as possible (TI datasheet requirement)

VWM 5.80V / VBR 6.45-7.14V @10mA / VC 10.5V @143A. Cathode (banded end) toward +5V - the KiCad symbol names both pins A1/A2 and shows no polarity, but the footprint silkscreen has the band. Clamps above U1 absolute max 7V, so it protects the NES, not the eFuse
Non-polarized; backup protection upstream of U1 eFuse. KiCad footprint field mislabeled as polarized cap footprint in v1 (fix in v2)

Flat side facing viewer, leads down = E-C-B left to right. Base=video in (through R2), Emitter=R1/C2 node, Collector=GND. 2SA1015 is obsolete and the market carries relabelled parts — source the KSA1015 (onsemi), same E-C-B pinout, still in production. Do not substitute 2N3906 or BC557 without re-checking the pinout; both differ.

Q1 emitter load: one end +5V, other end to Q1 emitter/C2 node. Not both ends to +5V. Raised from 300Ω for v2: at the assumed ~1.3V base, 300-330Ω supplies only ~6.2mA at peak white against the ~6.7mA the 150Ω load needs. 220Ω gives ~9.3mA and real headroom. Retune if the measured DC at J4.1 differs from ~1.3V.

Series resistor between J4.1 (video in from NES) and Q1's base. Mirrors the 330Ω Nintendo places in the same position. Negligible signal loss against Q1's ~21kΩ base input impedance; limits fault current into the base-emitter junction, whose reverse rating is only 5V. New in v2.
Video series termination; populated on the fabbed v1 board
Sets U1 current limit. I_OS = 25.9/R_ILIM(kohm) -> ~1.18A typ. Higher R = LOWER limit. Valid range 15k-232k
Adjustable OCP between F1 and the 5V rail. EN (pin 3) active-high tied to IN. Auto-retry version (the -1 suffix is latch-off). FAULT (pin 4) left unconnected
6-pin power-only (VBUS x2, GND x2, CC1, CC2); no data lines
Not a purchased part — bare plated holes for bring-up (video, GND, +5V, audio). Optionally fit 0.64mm square header pins for scope grabbers.
Series source termination for the mini-DIN RGB connector video pin (mirrors R5 for the RCA jack)
Feed to the panel-mounted 8-pin mini-DIN RGB connector: 1=video/sync, 2=GND, 3=+5V. Connector itself ships with the NESRGB kit and mounts in the shell.
